configuration.algorithm: REINFORCE, EMA baseline, reward +1 per decision survived

works.note: one training episode reached the full 300 decisions, which no constant action achieves on this window (best constant = 259 decisions)

bug_found_and_fixed.symptom: first run's mean return fell from ~84 (untrained) to 38 by episode 10; the policy was being destroyed, not trained
bug_found_and_fixed.cause: loss = sum(-logp) * advantage, so gradient scale ~ 300 x 300 = 9e4

no_signal_on_dev.verdict: no signal: the arm's mean is inside the bootstrap CI of a zero difference

why_no_signal.reading: 12 episodes is 6% of the prereg's budget; a policy-gradient run that needs 1e3-1e3 episodes costs 19-58 h per seed at 70 s/episode, and a 3-seed x 4-window study costs 60-230 h. The binding constraint is the missing engine save-state: 96% of every episode is replaying the 8,663 frame prefix, not learning.

decision_rule_outcome.gate: arm A must beat C-fair on dev before the pixel arms are attempted
decision_rule_outcome.result: arm A does NOT beat C-fair
decision_rule_outcome.action_per_prereg: stop and inspect reward / exploration / optimisation before anything else

inspection_done.optimisation: found and fixed a gradient-scale bug (see bug_found_and_fixed)
inspection_done.exploration: entropy is not annealed and the initial policy is near-uniform; no evidence exploration is the blocker
inspection_done.reward: +1 per decision survived is dense; the terminal is the only 0, so the signal is not sparse in the usual sense
inspection_done.budget: 12 episodes vs the prereg's 200; the run is 6% of its own budget

do_not: do not proceed to pixel arms B/C on this result
do not report arm A as failed as a method - it was not run at budget

next_actions: run arm A to the prereg's 200 episodes on one window (~3.9 h) before judging it
or first build the engine save-state, which cuts episode cost by ~25x and makes a 3-seed study affordable (this is the highest-value engineering prerequisite)
C-const-best remains unbeaten by any policy so far: it is the second gate
